newsitem.title: USA: Dominion Resources unit sells $819 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Resources unit sells $819 mln notes.

text.p: The following two-tranche debt issue from DR Investments was priced in the 144A private placement on Tuesday via Lehman Brothers, according to market sources.
DR Investments is a unit of Dominion Resources.
Dominion Resources is an electric utility company serving Virginia and parts of North Carolina
